scripts.test:e2e: corepack pnpm --dir examples/folk-todo test:e2e && corepack pnpm --dir examples/puddy-vite test:e2e && corepack pnpm --dir examples/linearlite test:e2e && corepack pnpm --dir examples/catalog test:e2e
scripts.rust:clippy: cd crates && cargo clippy --locked --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings -D clippy::ignore-without-reason && cargo clippy --locked -p jam-engine-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -- -D warnings
scripts.rust:no-ignored-tests: if grep -rn --include='*.rs' --exclude-dir=target -E '#\[ignore' crates; then echo 'ignored tests are not allowed; delete or fix them' >&2; exit 1; fi
scripts.rust:bench: cd crates && cargo bench --locked -p jam-engine --bench engine -- --sample-size 10 --measurement-time 1 --warm-up-time 1 --noplot
scripts.rust:check: corepack pnpm rust:fmt && corepack pnpm rust:clippy && corepack pnpm rust:deny && corepack pnpm rust:no-ignored-tests && corepack pnpm rust:test
